beat: Chotu asks how earlier kiss felt; Dhika recalls it and initiates another brief kiss

lines.original: Dhika: smiling happily now... good... should be always brave and bold..... like the time you kissed me... hehe... she said and bit her tongue....
lines.local: Dhika khush hokar: Good. Hamesha brave aur bold raho... jaise us din mujhe kiss kiya tha! Hehe. Woh apni jeebh kaat gayi.

lines.original: Chotu: uhnnn....eeee..... hehe... he just made squeaky noises....
lines.local: Chotu: Uhnn... eee... hehe. Woh ajeeb si shy awaazein nikaalne laga.

lines.original: Dhika: hehehehehe... first time you kiss a girl and when she talks about it.... you are making strange noises... she giggled....
lines.local: Dhika: Hehehe, pehli baar ladki ko kiss kiya aur ab uske baare mein bolun toh aisi awaazein? Woh hansi.

lines.original: Chotu: didi... may I ask something ?
lines.local: Chotu: Didi, kuch poochh sakta hoon?

lines.original: Dhika: of course dear... anything..she giggled.
lines.local: Dhika: Zaroor dear, kuch bhi. Woh giggle ki.

lines.original: Chotu: how was my kiss.....
lines.local: Chotu: Mera kiss kaisa tha?

lines.original: Dhika: taken aback by the question a little.... (  she didn't really think how it was and everything.)..... uhnnnnnn.... (  she didn't know what to say, yet)
lines.local: Achanak sawaal sunkar Dhika thoda tham gayi; usne sach mein kabhi evaluate nahi kiya tha. Uhnn... use abhi samajh nahi aa raha tha kya kahe.

lines.original: Chotu: feeling her silence...that bad huh ? he felt sad....
lines.local: Uski khamoshi se Chotu udaas: Itna kharaab tha kya?

lines.original: Dhika: no no......
lines.local: Dhika: Nahi nahi!

lines.original: Chotu: feeling bad for himself.....its okay didi.... I thought so too.....
lines.local: Chotu khud se mayoos: Theek hai didi, mujhe bhi laga tha.

lines.original: Dhika: no dear... you just asked suddenly and I didn't think about it....
lines.local: Dhika: Nahi dear, tumne achanak poochh liya. Maine us tarah socha hi nahi tha.

lines.original: She stood up and slowly paced along the length of the sofa thinking about the kiss..... it was.....
lines.local: Dhika sofa ke saath dheere-dheere chalte hue pehle wale kiss ko yaad karne lagi.

lines.original: Chotu: Its okay didi.. he just felt little frustrated on himself...... he laid on the sofa on his back and looked blankly at the ceiling... thinking.....
lines.local: Chotu ne khud se frustration mein: It's okay didi. Woh peeth ke bal sofa par let gaya aur chhat ki taraf khaali nazron se dekhne laga.

lines.original: Ignoring his pouting... she was remembering what happened last time.... She was lying on the sofa... and Chotu felling the need to kiss her... quickly came at her and gave a sweet peck at her lips... Astonishing to herself, she too kissed him back....it was a soft kiss...she blushed.... smiling,she thought that she felt it as "so cute"....
lines.local: Uske pout ko nazarandaaz kar Dhika purana moment yaad kar rahi thi: woh sofa par leti thi, Chotu achanak uske paas aaya aur honton par soft peck diya; use khud hairaani hui ki usne bhi kiss return kiya. Woh bahut soft tha. Yeh yaad karte hue woh blush hui aur use 'so cute' laga.

lines.original: She wanted to tell him this .... and looked towards his direction to see him lying on the sofa just like she was lying on it the last time.... on his back.... watching up....
lines.local: Woh Chotu ko apna jawaab dena chahti thi. Mudkar dekha toh woh bilkul uske pichhli baar wale posture mein peeth ke bal sofa par, upar dekh raha tha.

lines.original: Chotu: eyes closed......I am never kissing another women.... he said to himself in a funny frustration tone....
lines.local: Chotu aankhein band karke mazaakia frustration mein khud se: Main dobara kabhi kisi ladki ko kiss nahi karunga.

lines.original: Dhika: giggling, oh shut up..... she moved towards him
lines.local: Dhika giggle karte hue: Oho, chup bhi karo! Woh uski taraf badhi.

lines.original: moving.....she suddenly fell on her knees, next to the sofa....
lines.local: Paas aakar woh achanak sofa ke bagal mein ghutnon par baith gayi.

lines.original: leaning on him, she wrapped her arms around his head and looked down at him for a second...
lines.local: Uske upar halka jhukkar usne dono baahein uske sir ke ird-gird rakhi aur ek second uski taraf dekha.

lines.original: Chotu felt a soft weight on him.....opening his eyes full... what he saw was another pair of eyes looking with giggling eyes straight at him....
lines.local: Chotu ne apne upar halki si weight mehsoos ki; aankhein poori kholi toh seedha apni taraf dekh rahi Dhika ki hansti aankhein dikhin.

lines.original: She pressed her lips tightly into him and held it there....
lines.local: Dhika ne apne hont uske honton par mazbooti se lagaaye aur kuch der wahin roke rakhe.

lines.original: and when she left his lips 3 seconds later... she saw him blinking at her, surprised but smiling lightly.....
lines.local: Takreeban teen seconds baad woh alag hui; Chotu hairaan tha, halki smile ke saath palkein jhapka raha tha.

lines.original: Dhika: "your last kiss... "It was cute"".....she giggled looking into his blinking eyes....
lines.local: Dhika uski aankhon mein hanste hue: Tumhara pichhla kiss... 'cute' tha!
